title: JetBrains Air — Agentic Development Cheat Sheet
brandSub: Air · Agents · Cloud Tasks · Automations · MCP

rows.label: What is Air
rows.value: Agentic Development Environment — delegate coding tasks to AI agents, watch & steer them in parallel

rows.label: Install macOS
rows.value: Download from air.dev or use JetBrains Toolbox

rows.label: Install Linux
rows.value: curl -fsSL https://jb.gg/air-install.sh | sh

rows.label: Install Windows
rows.value: Install via JetBrains Toolbox only

rows.label: Web version
rows.value: Open https://air.jetbrains.cloud — org admin must enable it first

rows.label: Sign in
rows.value: Connect at least one AI provider on first launch; use Settings | Account | AI Providers later

rows.label: JetBrains AI sub
rows.value: One subscription unlocks Claude Agent, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Junie via AI credits

rows.label: BYOK / own account
rows.value: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google account connected directly; spends that account's quota

rows.label: Cloud tasks (EAP)
rows.value: Run tasks in remote containerized environments; results pushed to a task branch air/<task>

rows.label: Automations (EAP)
rows.value: Trigger-based cloud tasks — schedule, GitHub events, or incoming webhooks; managed at air.jetbrains.cloud

rows.label: MCP Connectors (EAP)
rows.value: Managed GUI connections to MCP servers (GitHub, Jira, Figma, Sentry…) — no config file needed

rows.label: Projects (EAP)
rows.value: Team resource groups: shared environments, automations, connectors, and members in one place

rows.label: Multi-repo clone (EAP)
rows.value: Clone additional repos in cloud via .air/cloud/startup.sh — native multi-repo support is planned

rows.label: Cloud env lifecycle
rows.value: Suspends after 75 min idle; archived after 24 h; results stay on the task branch

rows.label: Snapshots (EAP)
rows.value: Cloud env state saved between runs for faster starts; startup script installs are cached in the snapshot

rows.label: Gemini CLI note
rows.value: Gemini CLI is temporarily unavailable for cloud tasks (as of August 2026)

rows.label: Chat tool
rows.value: Always-available entry point — describe goal, add context, press Enter or click Send

rows.label: Voice input
rows.value: Click microphone icon; uses local Whisper model — no audio sent to cloud; download model in Settings | Voice Input

rows.label: @ context
rows.value: Type @ in task input to attach files, folders, symbols, Git branches/commits, terminals, or local changes

rows.label: Add to Task
rows.value: Select code in editor → Add to Task to attach the exact snippet as context

rows.label: Upload file
rows.value: Type / → Upload File from Computer to attach logs, screenshots, or specs

rows.label: Slash commands
rows.value: Type / to open the slash menu; lists predefined commands, custom commands, and skills

rows.label: Project instructions
rows.value: CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .claude/settings.json — Air picks these up automatically

rows.label: Plan mode
rows.value: Select Plan permission mode; agent writes plan to .air/plans/ before touching code

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Fastest startup; agent edits your working copy directly on the current branch — no isolation

rows.label: Git Worktree
rows.value: Separate working copy on branch air/<task>; your main stays untouched; configure via .air/worktree.json

rows.label: Docker
rows.value: Fully isolated container; requires Docker Desktop + valid license; configure via .air/docker.json

rows.label: Cloud (EAP)
rows.value: Remote JetBrains-managed container; agent pushes result to task branch; create PR to integrate

rows.label: worktree.json
rows.value: environment, setup (per OS), and cleanup sections for vars, pre-agent, and post-task commands

rows.label: docker.json — image
rows.value: "image": "ubuntu:24.04" for a prebuilt image; or use "build" with a Dockerfile path

rows.label: Docker user
rows.value: Omit user → Air creates airuser:agents with sudo; specify user for custom images

rows.label: Startup script
rows.value: .air/cloud/startup.sh — runs after repo clone but before agent; must be idempotent

rows.label: Built-in agents
rows.value: Claude Agent (Anthropic), OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Junie — select per task in Chat toolbar

rows.label: Switch model mid-task
rows.value: Model can be changed during a task; agent (provider) cannot be changed once the task is started

rows.label: Add ACP agent
rows.value: Click agent selector → Add ACP Agent; opens global acp.json; add entry under agent_servers

rows.label: acp.json format
rows.value: {"agent_servers":{"Goose":{"command":"goose","args":["acp"]}}}

rows.label: Edit ACP config later
rows.value: Press CtrlShiftK → run action Edit ACP JSON File

rows.label: Effort / Thinking
rows.value: Set reasoning depth (Low → Max) in task toolbar for agents that support it; higher = more tokens

rows.label: Cloud agent limits
rows.value: In cloud tasks only org-approved agents are available; BYOK accounts work for local runs only

rows.label: Docker + Claude sub
rows.value: Claude subscription credentials can't be passed into Docker; use Anthropic API billing or JetBrains AI credits instead

rows.label: Plan
rows.value: Agent creates a Markdown plan in .air/plans/; you approve before implementation starts

rows.label: Ask / Ask Permission
rows.value: Agent asks for approval before editing files or running commands — safest for sensitive work

rows.label: Edit / Auto-Edit
rows.value: Agent edits files automatically; still more restricted than Full Access

rows.label: Full Access
rows.value: Fewest restrictions for the chosen agent — use only when you trust the project and understand the risks

rows.label: Cycle modes
rows.value: Press Shift+Tab in Chat toolbar to cycle through available permission modes

rows.label: When to use Plan
rows.value: Multi-file or multi-module changes, unclear scope, or when the agent may need to ask clarifying questions

rows.label: Implement dialog
rows.value: After plan is ready, Air shows an Implement dialog — approve to start code changes

rows.label: Shared skills
rows.value: Store reusable workflow modules in .agents/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md — all agents read this location

rows.label: Claude skills
rows.value: Agent-specific skills also loaded from .claude/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md

rows.label: Codex skills
rows.value: Agent-specific skills from .codex/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md

rows.label: Gemini skills
rows.value: Agent-specific skills from .gemini/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md

rows.label: Custom Claude cmds
rows.value: Markdown files in .claude/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Custom Gemini cmds
rows.value: TOML files in .gemini/commands/<name>.toml

rows.label: Custom Junie cmds
rows.value: Markdown files in .junie/commands/<name>.md

rows.label: Skills vs commands
rows.value: Commands are explicit invocations; skills are loaded by the agent when they match the task context

rows.label: Enable MCP
rows.value: Settings | AI | MCP Servers → turn on Enable MCP support

rows.label: Global MCP
rows.value: Click Add Global MCP Server — available in all projects on your machine

rows.label: Local MCP
rows.value: Add Local MCP Server → stored in .air/mcp.json in the project root; commit to share with team

rows.label: Workspace MCP
rows.value: Add Workspace MCP Server → uses standard .mcp.json in repo root; enable Launch workspace MCP servers

rows.label: Auth: bearer token
rows.value: Provide token directly in mcp.json under headers.Authorization — env-var tokens not supported

rows.label: Auth: OAuth
rows.value: Server appears with a Connect button; click to open provider's authorization page

rows.label: Connectors vs mcp.json
rows.value: Connectors (web UI) give guided GUI setup; mcp.json for servers not available as connectors — both work together

rows.label: GitHub connector
rows.value: Always enabled for automations — GitHub MCP server is always available; cannot be disabled

rows.label: Open diff
rows.value: After task finishes, click the +512 -4 statistics in Chat to open Task Changes tab

rows.label: Diff views
rows.value: Switch between Unified and Side-by-side in the diff header toolbar

rows.label: Comment on line
rows.value: Click the + gutter icon on a diff line → enter comment → Add Comment or Send Comments

rows.label: Send comments
rows.value: Open Comments tool → select comments you agree with → Send — agent uses them as follow-up instructions

rows.label: Review with agent
rows.value: Click Review with <agent> button — runs a separate review task with its own fresh context

rows.label: Review scope via /
rows.value: Type / → Review with <agent> → choose Task Changes, Local Changes, files, folders, commits, or branches

rows.label: Project review prompt
rows.value: Override global review focus per repo: stored in .air/review/review-prompt.md

rows.label: Second-opinion review
rows.value: Click arrow next to Review with button to select a different agent and model for an independent pass

rows.label: Local Workspace
rows.value: Agent already wrote to your working copy — open Changes tool, commit, and push

rows.label: Generate commit msg
rows.value: Click Generate Commit Message icon next to Commit in the Changes tool

rows.label: Apply Locally
rows.value: From isolated env (Worktree/Docker): Apply Locally copies uncommitted changes to your working copy

rows.label: Check Out Branch
rows.value: Drop-down next to Apply Locally → Check Out Branch Locally → creates local branch with suffix -copy

rows.label: Cloud task PR
rows.value: Click Create PR in the cloud task to open a pull request from the pushed task branch

rows.label: Revert single file
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert icon next to the file name

rows.label: Revert all
rows.value: Changes tool → Task Changes tab → click Revert All

rows.label: Roll back branch
rows.value: History tool → right-click commit → Reset Current Branch To Here (Mixed / Keep / Hard)

rows.label: New task shortcut
rows.value: Press CtrlN or click the New Task icon in the Tasks tool

rows.label: Switch workspace
rows.value: Open workspace selector in task header, or press Alt1 and select in Tasks tool

rows.label: Input required
rows.value: Task pauses with Input required label; click notification Open Task to unblock it

rows.label: Resume suspended
rows.value: Tasks tool → select task with Suspended status → click Resume; restart any running processes

rows.label: Parallel isolation
rows.value: Use Git Worktree or Docker for parallel tasks touching the same files — prevents conflicts

rows.label: Task grouping
rows.value: Tasks tool settings icon → group by Date, Status, or Target

rows.label: Open in IDE
rows.value: Click IDE selector (top-right corner) → choose an installed IntelliJ-based IDE for debugging or refactoring

rows.label: Shallow clone
rows.value: Cloud env clones only the latest commit; ask agent to run git fetch --unshallow if history is needed

rows.label: New env config
rows.value: Web UI: Settings | Environments → New Environment; select repo, VM size, internet access, vars & secrets

rows.label: VM sizes
rows.value: Small (2 CPU/8 GB), Medium (4/16), Large (8/32), Extra Large (16 CPU/64 GB/100 GB disk)

rows.label: Internet access modes
rows.value: Off · Specified domains · Trusted domains (preset list) · All domains — prefer narrowest scope

rows.label: Secret types
rows.value: Personal secret: encrypted, only you; Shared secret: encrypted, all with access; Env var: plain text

rows.label: Config changes
rows.value: Edit env config → start a new task — existing tasks keep the environment they started with

rows.label: Resume cloud task
rows.value: Suspended tasks: click Resume; archived after 24 h — results still on task branch

rows.label: Cloud credits
rows.value: Cloud tasks always spend JetBrains AI credits; BYOK accounts work for local runs only

rows.label: Create automation
rows.value: Web UI: Automations page → New Automation; set prompt, model, connectors, triggers, and change handling

rows.label: Trigger: schedule
rows.value: At time (specific days/time) or Repeat every (fixed interval)

rows.label: Trigger: GitHub events
rows.value: PR opened/merged/labeled, PR review requested/received, issue opened/labeled, workflow failed/job failed

rows.label: Trigger: webhook
rows.value: POST to .../api/v1/events/automations/<id> with Authorization: ApiKey <token>; JSON body is optional

rows.label: Change handling
rows.value: No code changes · Push to source branch · Push to new branch · Create a PR — set per trigger

rows.label: Outgoing webhook
rows.value: Add notification URL; Air POSTs automation.execution.succeeded/failed events; Slack URL auto-uses slack-workflow format

rows.label: Run manually
rows.value: Automations page → select automation → Run Now; set branch, change handling, and optional context

rows.label: Continue run
rows.value: Open run → next to Open Chat → Continue in New Task — new cloud task picks up the run's branch & context

rows.label: Push shortcut
rows.value: CtrlShiftG, CtrlShiftP

rows.label: Pull shortcut
rows.value: CtrlShiftG, CtrlShiftU

rows.label: File history
rows.value: CtrlShiftG, CtrlShiftH — or Git menu → Current File | File History

rows.label: Branch selector
rows.value: Click branch name in task header; shows ↑ (unpushed) and ↓ (unpulled) counters

rows.label: Sync command
rows.value: Git | Sync — pulls remote then pushes local in one step; use when branch has drifted both ways

rows.label: Auto-fetch
rows.value: Settings | Tools | Git → enable Auto-fetch repositories to keep ↑↓ counters fresh

rows.label: Connect GitHub org
rows.value: Web UI: Settings | VCS Providers → install JetBrains Air GitHub app for the org; GitLab uses OAuth only

rows.label: History snapshots
rows.value: History tool interleaves Git commits with Before Request snapshots taken around each agent task

rows.label: AI credit limit
rows.value: Org admin sets monthly limit per user in JetBrains Central Console → AI governance | Settings

rows.label: Check credit usage
rows.value: Desktop: settings menu bottom-right shows usage + reset date; Web: Settings | Account

rows.label: Limit agents
rows.value: Central Console → AI governance | Policies → Agents tab — restricts which agents are available org-wide

rows.label: Allow cloud tasks
rows.value: Central Console → AI governance | Policies → General tab → enable Cloud tasks

rows.label: Allow connectors
rows.value: Central Console → AI governance | Policies → MCP tab → enable Other MCP servers

rows.label: Project service acct
rows.value: Each Project gets an auto-created service account; project automations spend its AI credits (GitHub only)

rows.label: Project roles
rows.value: Admin: full manage; Member: run tasks & use automations, cannot edit configs

rows.label: Shared env secrets
rows.value: Personal secrets are never shared when sharing an env config — each user must create their own

rows.label: Go to All
rows.value: Press CtrlK or Shift Shift — search files, symbols, actions, and tools in one popup

rows.label: Run any action
rows.value: Press CtrlShiftK — Actions tab of Go to All; type action name (e.g., git, find)

rows.label: Find usages
rows.value: CtrlU — or hold ⌘Cmd and click the symbol

rows.label: Go to definition
rows.value: CtrlB

rows.label: Go to implementations
rows.value: AltShiftB

rows.label: Find in Files
rows.value: CtrlShiftF — text search with folder & file-mask filters; add results to a task as context

rows.label: Replace in Files
rows.value: CtrlShiftH — or Toggle Replace in Search tool

rows.label: Open tool by name
rows.value: CtrlT — Tools tab of Go to All; type e.g. Chat, Changes, History

rows.label: Fan out work
rows.value: Run independent subtasks as separate parallel agents in Git Worktree or Docker to avoid file conflicts

rows.label: Bound each task
rows.value: Give the agent one clear, verifiable goal per task — broad goals lead to sprawling, hard-to-review diffs

rows.label: Keep approvals on
rows.value: Use Ask mode for any task touching sensitive config, credentials, or infra — review before each action

rows.label: Idempotent scripts
rows.value: Always write .air/cloud/startup.sh to be safe on repeated runs; guard installs with command -v checks

rows.label: Verify with commands
rows.value: After review, ask the agent to run newly added tests or the app itself to confirm the change works

rows.label: Seed review prompts
rows.value: Commit .air/review/review-prompt.md with your team's style guide, security rules, and test expectations

rows.label: Second-opinion review
rows.value: Use a different agent to review than the one that implemented — independent model catches different issues

rows.label: Startup script secrets
rows.value: Never log the GIT_JCP_AUTH_MAPPING refresh URL — anything that can read it can request a token
